sentences.en: Juha bought salt at the market in the morning.

sentences.ar: הוא שם אותו על החמור בשקים.
sentences.en: He put it on the donkey in sacks.
The road home passed beside a river.
The donkey went into the water slowly.
It fell and lay in the river.
The salt melted and disappeared in the water.
The donkey got up very light.
It continued on the road happily.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא ראה הכול ולא אמר כלום.
sentences.en: Juha saw everything and did not say anything.
The next week he bought wool.

sentences.ar: הוא שם אותו על אותו חמור.
sentences.en: He put it on the same donkey.
They came again to the river.
The donkey went in and lay down at once.
The wool took in all the water.
The donkey tried to get up and did not succeed.
Juha stood on the bank and smiled.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אתה חכם, אבל אני יותר.
sentences.en: He said: you are clever, but I am more so.
